name: What types of bathtubs does AKN Design Group install during a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What types of bathtubs does AKN Design Group install during a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group focuses on comprehensive luxury bathroom renovations that often include new bathtub installations. We work with various high-quality bathtub types, such as freestanding tubs, alcove tubs, drop-in tubs, and jetted tubs, to create a spa-inspired experience tailored to your preferences. The selection depends on your design vision, the available space, and the overall functionality you aim to achieve in your updated primary bathroom. Our design-build process ensures that the chosen bathtub seamlessly integrates with other elements like custom vanities, walk-in showers, and upgraded tile work.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group installs various high-quality bathtub types, including freestanding, alcove, drop-in, and jetted tubs, as part of comprehensive luxury bathroom renovations.
